text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: Still, I think you did your best!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
Even so... I truly wanted
to deliver a victory to you...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I won," is what...
I wanted to report to you...
...I'm so sorry.
choice_data_list: I'm happy just knowing you feel that way.
I'll be waiting to hear about that next time.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I want to bring you... true joy...
So that you don't have to worry about me..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...You will wait... for me, won't you?
Without giving up on me...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I will not let that kindness...
go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I will do my best, so... please,
don't spoil me too much, okay?
